text:
support-bot: [ALERT] 03:02 UTC elevated 401s for /v1/generate across multiple customers. Spike started ~02:50 UTC. Error = "invalid_token" / "signature_verification_failed". Automerged to #incidents
Maya: seeing same in support dashboard, lots of tickets about auth failures after midnight rotation. Any deploys around then?
Trevor: we rolled key-rotation job at 02:45 as part of monthly rotation. It was supposed to update JWKS and auth-service introspection in a canary then global rollout.
Olga: checking auth-service logs now. Getting a ton of 500s from jwks-refresh path and then downstream 401s from the API gateway verifying tokens against new keys.
Akshay (oncall): oncall here. Prioritize: 1) stop rollout, 2) restore previous JWKS, 3) triage affected customers.
Trevor: can confirm canary job failed with timeout talking to KMS; job retried and proceeded to other regions. Looks like a race: new keys written but JWKS publishing step errored intermittently.
Maya: customers reporting both API key 401s and SSO/OAuth token invalidation. Some say SDKs started failing too.
Olga: grabbing specific log snippet:
```
2026-06-02T02:46:12Z auth-service ERROR jwks_publisher: failed to publish jwks to s3: timeout connecting to kms endpoint
2026-06-02T02:46:13Z auth-service WARN key_rotation: new_key_created id=rot-2026-06-02-0246 but jwks_publish_failed=true
2026-06-02T02:48:01Z api-gateway ERROR token_verify: signature_verification_failed kid=rot-2026-06-02-0246 tried_kids=[prev-2026-04-12-0812]
```
Akshay (oncall): that detail suggests new key exists in KMS but JWKS file not updated, so clients/edge saw mixed state depending on which verifier they hit.
Trevor: pushing rollback to rotation manager now -- disabling new rotation and forcing publish of last-known-good JWKS.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rotation-manager/rollback-to-prev-jwks @ 02:58 UTC. Will run across regions with 60s stagger.
Maya: support to customers: send one-liner acknowledging auth failures, note we are rolling back rotation and will follow up. I can draft.
Support: draft please — send to me for review. Small risk of transient 500s during rollback.
Olga: workaround while rollback completes: set API gateway to accept tokens signed by either kid=prev-2026-04-12-0812 or the new kid (tolerate both) + bypass jwks cache for 30s. We can do temporary permissive verification to reduce outages.
Akshay (oncall): risk: permissive mode could accept an attacker if key compromised. But rotation was internal; risk lower than complete outage. Approve for 15m window.
Security: noted — require audit trail, increase logging for key access. Also, rotate and reissue any keys if we detect compromise.
Trevor: rotation-manager logs show retries to KMS due to transient network issue in us-east-1. We should add circuit-breaker so rotation doesn't propagate if jwks publish fails.
Maya: sending customer note now: "We’re investigating authentication errors affecting API requests since ~02:50 UTC. We are rolling back a key rotation and expect service to recover in ~10–20 minutes. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll follow up with root cause and mitigation." :pray:
Support: posting to customers, linking status.redwood.com incident.
support-bot: rollback job completed across all regions at 03:06 UTC. JWKS restored to prev-2026-04-12-0812. Edge verifiers reloaded.
Olga: verification: api-gateway token_verify errors dropped by 90% post-rollback. Some caches still TTLed — giving it another 5–10 minutes.
Akshay (oncall): running smoke tests now:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_OAUTH" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate | jq .status
# expected: 200
```
Trevor: thumbs up from smoke tests and prod traces show normal token validation rate.
Maya: customers reporting recovery. Triage: collect list of affected customers for crediting and follow-up.
Support: opening consolidated ticket to CC all impacted customers, include timeframe and action items.
Security: create post-incident task: (1) add stricter preconditions to rotation (fail closed if jwks publish fails), (2) circuit-breaker, (3) end-to-end integration test for KMS->JWKS pipeline, (4) alert on jwks_publish_failed metric.
Olga: root cause hypothesis: rotation job did not enforce atomic publish to JWKS; intermediate state where key created in KMS but JWKS missing caused signature mismatch.
Trevor: immediate fixes: stop any scheduled rotations until we've patched; add retry/backoff and atomic S3 write with consistent metadata; add preflight KMS connectivity check.
Akshay (oncall): postmortem owners: Trevor (infra), Olga (auth-service), Security (sec-team). Meeting set for 10:00 UTC to draft RCA and customer timeline.
Maya: draft post-incident customer note: brief incident summary, affected window 02:46–03:06 UTC, mitigation applied (rollback), next steps (patch rotation manager, improved tests), offer credits.
Support: copy approved. We'll schedule follow-up message after RCA.
Security: also check if any API keys were invalidated unexpectedly by the rotation; coordinate with billing for any retries that caused overage billing.
Trevor: logging todo: correlate rotation-manager events with KMS metrics and network errors. I’ll attach logs to the RCA.
Akshay (oncall): closing incident channel in 2 hours unless new regressions. Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Incident summary appended to tickets and status page. Channel will be archived after postmortem.
